statements.proposition: The 6 pattern-specific tests (tests/docker/verify-patterns.sh) were run and all 6 passed, giving 100% pattern test coverage.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: The script does contain exactly 6 numbered checks, so the count 6 matches. But the checks only grep 'claude-flow mcp tools' output for tool names, check 'mcp status', and compare the globally installed npm version to 2.7.1 (they test the published npm package, not the PR source). Pass/fail needs a run of the published claude-flow@2.7.1 package in Docker; my attempt to install that package into a sandbox prefix was denied by the permission system, so I did not run it. Also the script is set -e / always exits 0 even when log_fail fires, so a pass cannot be inferred from exit code. 'Coverage 100%' is loose wording for 6 of 6 checks, not code coverage. No CI result exists for this to settle it.
